# cpanel_directory_privacy (Resource)

Enables password protection for an existing directory in a cPanel account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cpanel_directory_privacy" "downloads" {
  directory = "public_html/downloads"
  auth_name = "Restricted downloads"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth_name` (String) The label displayed by HTTP Basic authentication.
- `directory` (String) The normalized directory path relative to the cPanel account home.

### Read-Only

- `absolute_directory` (String) The absolute directory path reported by cPanel.
- `auth_type` (String) The authentication type reported by cPanel. Managed protection uses `Basic`.
- `password_file` (String) The password file path reported by cPanel.
- `protected` (Boolean) Whether cPanel reports the directory as protected.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cpanel_directory_privacy.downloads public_html/downloads
```
